page_text_ocr_zh:
蚂蚁·战争
mǎ yǐ · zhàn zhēng
page_text_en:
Ants · War
mǎ yǐ · zhàn zhēng
summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，显示书名《蚂蚁·战争》及其拼音注音。

page_text_ocr_zh:
liǎng zhī mǎ yǐ jiǎn dào le yí liù zhī ma
两只蚂蚁捡到了一粒芝麻。
yí li xiāng pēn pēn de zhī ma
一粒香喷喷的芝麻。
tā men dāng rán hěn gāo xìng, tuō zhe zhī ma wǎng jiā
他们当然很高兴,拖着芝麻往家
zǒu. bàn lù shang, bèi liǎng zhī ài kàn rè nao de cì wèi
走。半路上,被两只爱看热闹的刺猬
kàn jiàn le
看见了。
cì wèi zài mǎ yǐ bì jīng de lù shang táng le gěn
刺猬在蚂蚁必经的路上,放了根
cǎo gùn, rán hòu kàn mǎ yǐ zěn
草棍,然后看蚂蚁怎
me kè fú zhàng ài
么克服障碍。
liǎng zhī cì wèi juē zhe pì gu
两只刺猬撅着屁股,
kàn de fēi cháng qǐ jīn
看得非常起劲。
liǎng zhī hóu zǐ zài shù shàng kàn dào le, yǐ wéi dì
两只猴子在树上看到了,以为地
shàng yǒu shén me bǎo bèi, jiù yí zhèn fēng shì de gǎn dào cì
上有什幺宝贝,就一阵风似的赶到刺
wèi de shēn hòu, kàn le qǐ lái
猬的身后,看了起来。
page_text_en:
liǎng zhī mǎ yǐ jiǎn dào le yí liù zhī ma
Two ants found a sesame seed.
yí li xiāng pēn pēn de zhī ma
A fragrant sesame seed.
tā men dāng rán hěn gāo xìng, tuō zhe zhī ma wǎng jiā
They were very happy, dragging the sesame seed home.
zǒu. bàn lù shang, bèi liǎng zhī ài kàn rè nao de cì wèi
On the way, they were spotted by two curious hedgehogs.
kàn jiàn le
who saw them.
cì wèi zài mǎ yǐ bì jīng de lù shang táng le gěn
The hedgehogs placed a stick on the ants' usual path.
cǎo gùn, rán hòu kàn mǎ yǐ zěn
A grass stick, then watched how the ants overcame the obstacle.
me kè fú zhàng ài
overcame the obstacle.
liǎng zhī cì wèi juē zhe pì gu
The two hedgehogs sat on their haunches,
kàn de fēi cháng qǐ jīn
watching with great excitement.
liǎng zhī hóu zǐ zài shù shàng kàn dào le, yǐ wéi dì
Two monkeys saw this from the tree, thinking there was
shàng yǒu shén me bǎo bèi, jiù yí zhèn fēng shì de gǎn dào cì
some treasure on the ground, and rushed over like the wind to
wèi de shēn hòu, kàn le qǐ lái
the hedgehogs' back, and started watching.
summary_zh: 两只蚂蚁捡到芝麻回家，途中被刺猬发现，刺猬在路中放草棍观察蚂蚁如何克服障碍，猴子在树上看到后也赶来围观。

page_text_ocr_zh:
liǎng zhī chuānshān jiǎ kàn dào le, yǐ wéi fā shēng le
两只穿山甲看到了,以为发生了
shén me dà shì, pǎo le guò lái, zài hóu zi shēn hòu diǎn qǐ
什么大事,跑了过来,在猴子身后踮起
jiǎo kàn le qǐ lái。
脚,看了起来。
liǎng zhī xiǎo hú li kàn dào le, yǐ wéi zhè lǐ yǒu
两只小狐狸看到了,以为这里有
shén me biàn yí kě zhàn, fēi kuài de bēn le guò lái, jǐ zài
什么便宜可占,飞快地奔了过来,挤在
chuānshān jiǎ shēn hòu
穿山甲身后。
liǎng zhī gǒu xióng kàn dào le, yǐ wéi shù shàng de fēng
两只狗熊看到了,以为树上的蜂
cháo dǎo xià le dì shang, tā liǎ bù xiǎng fàng guò zhè yàng
巢掉在了地上,他俩不想放过这样
de jī huì, gǎn kuài āi zài hú li shēn hòu
的机会,赶快挨在狐狸身后。
……
page_text_en:
liǎng zhī chuānshān jiǎ kàn dào le, yǐ wéi fā shēng le
Two pangolins saw it and thought something big had happened.
shén me dà shì, pǎo le guò lái, zài hóu zi shēn hòu diǎn qǐ
They ran over and stood on their toes behind the monkey to look.
jiǎo kàn le qǐ lái。

liǎng zhī xiǎo hú li kàn dào le, yǐ wéi zhè lǐ yǒu
Two little foxes saw it and thought there was something to gain.
shén me biàn yí kě zhàn, fēi kuài de bēn le guò lái, jǐ zài
They rushed over quickly and squeezed behind the pangolins.
chuānshān jiǎ shēn hòu

liǎng zhī gǒu xióng kàn dào le, yǐ wéi shù shàng de fēng
Two bear cubs saw it and thought the beehive from the tree had fallen to the ground.
cháo dǎo xià le dì shang, tā liǎ bù xiǎng fàng guò zhè yàng
They didn't want to miss such an opportunity.
de jī huì, gǎn kuài āi zài hú li shēn hòu
So they quickly squeezed behind the foxes.
……
summary_zh: 穿山甲、小狐狸和狗熊先后看到蚂蚁搬运芝麻的场景，误以为发生了大事或有便宜可占，纷纷跑来围观，挤在前面动物身后，形成了一条好奇的动物队伍。

page_text_ocr_zh:
他们一个挤一个，挤得太紧了，以至于刺猬再也受不了啦，他俩使劲地竖起满身的尖刺。
被刺痛的猴子往后一仰，撞着了穿山甲；被撞痛了的穿山甲，往后一靠，碰痛了小狐狸；被碰痛了的小狐狸往后一退，踩痛了狗熊……
于是，一场你推我挤、你踢我拉的混战开始了。
当蚂蚁早已把香喷喷的芝麻抬回家的时候，大路上，那场战争还在进行着呢。
page_text_en:
They squeezed one against the other, getting too tight, until the hedgehog couldn't stand it anymore, and the two of them forcefully raised their spiky bodies.
The monkey, stung by the spines, leaned back and bumped into the pangolin; the pangolin, hurt by the bump, leaned back and bumped into the little fox; the little fox, hurt by the bump, stepped back and stepped on the bear...
Thus, a chaotic battle of pushing, shoving, kicking, and pulling began.
When the ants had already carried the fragrant sesame seeds back home, on the big road, that battle was still going on.
summary_zh: 动物们因拥挤而互相碰撞，引发了一场混乱的混战，而蚂蚁早已将芝麻抬回家，路上的‘战争’仍在继续。

page_text_ocr_zh:
第二天，森林里出版的《绿色信息报》上，发表了一条重要消息——

绿色信息报
昨天大路上爆发的战争，损失惨重。
原因：争看两只蚂蚁抬
一粒香喷喷的芝麻。
page_text_en:
The next day, the forest's published 'Green Information Newspaper' released an important message——

Green Information Newspaper
Yesterday's war on the main road caused heavy losses.
Reason: Fighting to watch two ants carry
a single fragrant sesame seed.
summary_zh: 第二天，森林里出版的《绿色信息报》报道了前一天大路上爆发的‘战争’，称其损失惨重，原因是动物们争着看两只蚂蚁抬一粒芝麻。
